02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Unified directory of federal/emirate authorities, housing & land regulations
02_government_sources.limitations: High-level policy; plot-level data delegated to emirate authorities

02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Federal road networks (E11, E311, E611, E84), Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme, federal buildings
02_government_sources.limitations: Detailed engineering drawings require contractor registration

02_government_sources.authority: Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (FCSC) & Bayanat.ae
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: 3,000+ open CSV/JSON/XLSX datasets: GDP by construction sector, building permits, population, cement/steel indices

02_government_sources.authority: Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT) & ADREC / DARI
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: DARI Off-Plan Project Directory, Licensed Developers/Brokers, Escrow Accounts, Sales & Rental Transaction Indices, Estidama Pearl ratings, GIS land layers
02_government_sources.access_terms: Public web search on DARI + Open Data on data.abudhabi
02_government_sources.limitations: Plot-specific Affection Plans & FAR require owner/consultant UAE Pass login

02_government_sources.authority: Abu Dhabi Mobility (Integrated Transport Centre - ITC)
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Road capacity upgrades, DARB toll gates, Asateel heavy truck permit windows, TIS traffic impact guidelines
02_government_sources.limitations: Real-time loop detector streams require API partnership

02_government_sources.authority: Dubai Land Department (DLD) & Dubai Pulse Open Data
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Open CSV & REST APIs: dld_transactions, dld_projects (with % completion & escrow bank), dld_buildings, dld_units, dld_brokers, dld_rent_contracts (Ejari)
02_government_sources.access_terms: Dubai Open Data License (Free CSV download & API)
02_government_sources.limitations: Owner personal names redacted under UAE PDPL

02_government_sources.authority: Dubai Municipality (DM) & Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Dubai Building Code (DBC), Makani GIS coordinates, parcel boundaries, building permit statistics, Tasreef drainage masterplan
02_government_sources.access_terms: Public GIS viewer + open permit stats
02_government_sources.limitations: Plot FAR/setback Affection Plans & structural drawings require Dubai BPS consultant login

02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Dubai Metro Blue Line specs, major road upgrade contracts (Hessa St, Al Khail Rd, Umm Suqeim), truck ban schedules, Salik dynamic toll data
02_government_sources.access_terms: Public Press & Dubai Pulse RTA datasets
02_government_sources.limitations: Project-specific Traffic Impact Study (TIS) models are confidential

02_government_sources.authority: Sharjah Municipality, SRERD & Sharjah Roads & Transport Authority (SRTA)
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Sharjah Real Estate Transaction Reports, Engineering building permit rules, SRTA road corridors & heavy truck timings
02_government_sources.limitations: No bulk CSV download portal comparable to Dubai Pulse

02_government_sources.authority: Ajman Municipality & Planning Dept (MPDA), ARRA & Ajman Transport
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Approved freehold projects, escrow registries, Tasdeeq rental stats, Ajman Vision 2030 urban plans
02_government_sources.limitations: Granular unit-level datasets not published as bulk CSV

02_government_sources.authority: RAK Municipality, Marjan & RAK Transport Authority (RAKTA)
02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Al Marjan Island masterplan guidelines, Barjeel green building regulations, RAK GIS portal, RAK Central & road upgrades
02_government_sources.public_availability_verified: Verified (Note: marjan.ae is official; marjan.ae is unrelated US art site)
02_government_sources.limitations: Plot-level permits require RAK e-Government consultant login

02_government_sources.datasets_provided: UAQ Sustainable Blue Economy Strategy 2031, Siniya Island & Downtown UAQ master approvals, building permits
02_government_sources.limitations: Project documents primarily hosted by joint-venture developer (Sobha)

02_government_sources.datasets_provided: Fujairah 2040 Plan, building regulations, coastal & industrial zoning, Dibba/Al Aqah tourism permits
02_government_sources.limitations: No open REST API for real estate transactions
